illustrative_examples.title: Same pronunciation
illustrative_examples.comment: ASSET, the fixed grid and the phone oracle write 它 for 他. Both are tā. The character oracle preserves the reference pronoun.

illustrative_examples.title: Same syllable, different tone
illustrative_examples.comment: ASSET changes 亲子沟通 (parent–child communication) to 亲自沟通 (communicate in person). The three baselines preserve 亲子.

illustrative_examples.title: Changed time
illustrative_examples.comment: The phone oracle writes 12:15 for 19:26. The other three systems preserve the time.

illustrative_examples.title: Changed person name
illustrative_examples.comment: The character oracle writes 秦红 for 秦虹. Both name spellings have the same Pinyin reading. ASSET preserves the reference spelling.
